notes: Dashboard 'Diem Checklist' (Bao cao -> Diem Checklist), 2 tab: (1) Tab 'Hien tai' - bo control chon thang lich su (input month), thay bang nhan readonly 'Ky hien tai: Thang MM/YYYY'; sua o tim kiem thuc su goi lai API (truoc day chi set state, khong reload cho toi khi bam Lam moi) - them debounce 400ms + giu phim Enter; nhan manh diem hien tai <100 (class is-warning) va <70 (is-danger, dung lai dung nguong 'Duoi nguong' da co); cot Tong loi = 0 hien '-' (giam nhieu thi giac), >0 hien so that va in dam - quy uoc UI thuan tuy, KHONG doi du lieu backend, KHONG ap dung cho cac cot diem. (2) Tab 'Theo ky' - VIET LAI HOAN TOAN: truoc day an theo reportUiState.data (tab Tong hop cu), chi 1 ky, khong co filter rieng; gio goi action rieng getChecklistScorePeriodReport() (lib/checklist-reports.js, moi, khong dong toi getChecklistMonthlyReport - tab Tong hop giu nguyen 100%), ho tro Tu ky/Den ky toi 12 ky, filter Phong ban/Chi nhanh/Tim kiem rieng + shortcut 3/6/12 thang. Nhan su thuoc pham vi hien tai nhung khong co phieu o mot ky van xuat hien (hasForm:false, diem null) thay vi bien mat. Sua dung quy tac null-vs-0: self_total_score/review_total_score duoc ghi ngay khi luu nhap (truoc submit) nen 'co so trong DB' khong dong nghia 'da tu danh gia/tham dinh that' - gate theo self_saved_at/self_submitted_at (tuong ung review) truoc khi tra so, tra null neu chua tung dung toi (hien '-', khac 0 that). 1 ky: bang 2-tang-header (Nhan su | Ket qua danh gia ky | Trang thai | Thao tac) + summary trung bi nh chi tinh gia tri numeric thuc su ton tai. 2-4 ky: 3 cot/ky (Tu danh/Tham dinh/Diem cuoi), KHONG summary (khong du y nghia quan tri ro trong batch nay). 5-12 ky: mac dinh chi Diem cuoi, toggle 'Day du', bang cuon ngang rieng khong lam vo page. Modal 'Xem chi tiet' moi (doc thang du lieu da tai, KHONG goi them API, KHONG phai workflow engine moi) dung cho ca 2 dang bang. Snapshot department/branch/title tren phieu KHONG bi current org ghi de khi phieu ton tai; kỳ khong co phieu dung current org lam placeholder (khong co snapshot de hien). Permission: dung lai đung getChecklistReportAccess() (khong tao quyen moi, khong doi scope). API parity: server.js (dev server co dispatch RIENG, khong chi delegate api/data.js - da phat hien va sua ca 2 noi) + api/data.js deu da wire action moi.
